title: Scholarly Distance and Irony in Biographical Reflection

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Antal Szerb's historical essays demonstrate that true wisdom lies in renouncing the illusion of infallibility (*tévedhetetlenség*). His writing employs profound scholarly humility (*tudósi alázat*), questioning sweeping claims and highlighting the frailties of human nature.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Scholarly distancing in this tradition is achieved by replacing grand assertions with interrogatives, tentative modals, and gentle smiles: *Biztosak lehetünk-e ebben? Aligha. De talán éppen a bizonytalanság teszi széppé a keresést.*
